capabilities: Style bullet markers and text by nesting depth
Apply regex-based formatting rules to bullet lines
Render child bullets of colon-ending parents as numbered lists
Configure bullet indentation and spacing widths per level
Jump between bullets of the same indentation with hotkeys
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; install is manual (unzip into .obsidian/plugins), not via the community plugin browser. Exposes CSS custom properties (--bb-control, --bb-number-children) and state classes for use in custom snippets.
problem: Obsidian renders all list bullets with the same marker and size, so deeply nested outlines are visually flat and hard to scan.
summary: Bullet-list styling plugin that changes bullet symbols, sizes, and text formatting by nesting depth and regex rules to improve readability.
